resources.string: The log of the watch app is saved as a zip file in the Downloads folder of the phone. Over Wi-Fi it holds all log files of the last days. Over Bluetooth it holds only the newest ones, because Bluetooth is slow.

string.name: wear_log_preparing
string.comment: %1$s=name of the watch. Example: Pixel Watch is putting its log in a zip…

resources.string: %1$s is putting its log in a zip…

string.name: wear_log_receiving
string.comment: %1$s=name of the watch, %2$d=percent received. Example: Receiving from Pixel Watch: 42%

string.name: wear_log_receiving_time_left
string.comment: %1$s=name of the watch, %2$d=percent received, %3$s=time left with its unit. Example: Receiving from Pixel Watch: 42%, about 3 min left

string.name: wear_log_saved
string.comment: %1$s=file name. Example: Saved in Downloads as AndroidAPS_WEAR_LOG_2026-11-17_14-05-00.zip

resources.string: The watch does not answer. The watch app on it may be too old for this: update it first with \"Update watch app\".

string.name: wear_log_failed
string.comment: %1$s=reason, in English. Example: Download failed: The log folder is not known
